from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from urllib.parse import urljoin,urlparse,urlunparse
import hashlib,json,requests
P=Path.cwd();R=P/'reports/research/510300_electricity_original_publication_state_v1'
now=lambda:datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
page=R/'raw/catalogue_index.htm'
dom=BeautifulSoup(page.read_bytes(),'html.parser').find(id='showData0')
data=dom['data'].split(':',1)[1];preview='category_' if dom.get('datatype')=='category' else dom['preview']
u=urljoin('https://www.nea.gov.cn/xwfb/index.htm','./'+preview+data+'.json')
q=R/'raw/actual_national_news_catalogue.json'
if q.exists():raise RuntimeError('实际动态列表已收件，不重发')
registration={'registered_at':now(),'catalogue_html_sha256':hashlib.sha256(page.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'loader_sha256':hashlib.sha256((R/'raw/actual_catalogue_loader.js').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'actual_dom':str(dom),'loader_rule':"sourceUrl = './'+preview+datasource+'.json'; 此处datatype=ds,preview=ds_", 'url':u,'publisher':'国家能源局原目录同域JSON','query_parameters':None,'same_original_budget':True,'original_period_and_pool_unchanged':True}
(R/'03_实际动态列表地址绑定_请求前.json').write_text(json.dumps(registration,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
z={'requested_url':u,'started_at':now(),'method':'GET','automatic_redirects':False,'retries':0,'credentials_used':False,'role':'ACTUAL_PUBLIC_CATALOGUE_JSON'}
try:
 with requests.Session() as sess:
  sess.trust_env=False
  a=sess.get(u,timeout=(10,25),allow_redirects=False,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; public historical research)'})
  q.write_bytes(a.content)
  z.update({'status_code':a.status_code,'received_at':now(),'bytes':len(a.content),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(a.content).hexdigest(),'raw_path':str(q.relative_to(P)).replace('\\','/'),'content_type':a.headers.get('Content-Type'),'redirect_location':a.headers.get('Location')})
except Exception as e:z.update({'status_code':None,'received_at':now(),'bytes':0,'error_type':type(e).__name__,'error':str(e)})
ledger=json.loads((R/'目录请求账本.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));ledger.append(z)
(R/'目录请求账本.json').write_text(json.dumps(ledger,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(z,ensure_ascii=False))
if z['status_code']==200:
 v=json.loads(q.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
 rows=v.get('datasource',[])
 prior=json.loads((R/'目录实际全国用电量标题锚点.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
 candidates={x['url']:x for x in prior}
 elec=[]
 for x in rows:
  t=BeautifulSoup(x.get('showTitle',''),'html.parser').get_text(' ',strip=True)
  if '全社会用电量' not in t:continue
  original=x.get('publishUrl','');o=urlparse(urljoin(u,original))
  if o.hostname!='www.nea.gov.cn':continue
  new=urlunparse(o._replace(scheme='https',fragment=''))
  rec={'url':new,'original_anchor_url':original,'title':t,'catalogue_url':u,'directory_publishTime':x.get('publishTime'),'original_catalogue_item':x}
  candidates[new]=rec;elec.append(rec)
 vals=sorted(candidates.values(),key=lambda x:x.get('directory_publishTime') or x['url'])
 (R/'目录实际全国用电量标题锚点_动态补充.json').write_text(json.dumps(vals,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
 print(json.dumps({'实际所有目录记录':len(rows),'实际全国消费标题':len(elec),'结构':list(v),'最新三':elec[:3],'最早三':elec[-3:]},ensure_ascii=False))
